The count is **72,576,000**.

For a fixed triple of positions $i<j<k$, the condition $\pi(j)<\pi(k)<\pi(i)$ fixes the relative order of the three values $\pi(i),\pi(j),\pi(k)$. Of the $3!=6$ possible relative orders of three distinct values, exactly one satisfies it. Over all $10!$ permutations, each triple of positions therefore satisfies the condition for $10!/6$ permutations.

There are $\binom{10}{3}=120$ triples of positions, so the total is

$$120\cdot\frac{10!}{6}=20\cdot 10! = 20\cdot 3628800 = 72576000.$$

ANSWER: 72576000
